channel.title: Burkina Faso - The African Street Journal
channel.description: Daily news from Burkina Faso, every source cited.

item.title: Burkina Faso security seizes knives at craft fair
item.description: Ouagadougou police confiscated sharp objects and prohibited items on the first day of the 18th SIAO craft exhibition.

item.title: Burkina Faso PM meets diaspora in Moscow
item.description: Prime Minister Rimtalba Jean Emmanuel Ouédraogo discussed administrative documents and scholarships with Burkinabè citizens in Russia.

item.title: Burkina Faso learns from China's targeted poverty fight
item.description: Adapting to local realities, China's poverty reduction strategy focuses on specific household needs and resources.

item.title: Burkina Faso official sentenced to two months in jail
item.description: Lebinoua Nikièma received a 12-month sentence, with two months suspended, and a fine for inciting unrest.

item.title: Le Cercle Rose raises funds for breast cancer screening
item.description: An event in Ouagadougou on October 24, 2026, aimed to fund screening for 100 vulnerable women.
